title: Invertibility of the proper Brown scalar mate
statement:
For the proper strict-etale Brown data and m≤n with finite source quotient ring, the normalized geometric mate of the derivedTensor comparison is an isomorphism of functors:
```lean
IsIso ((mateEquiv (B.level n).adjunction (B.level m).adjunction
  (.mk _ _ _ _ (B.derivedTensor h).hom)).natTrans)
```

source.place: Construction 4.1, Constructions 5.14–5.15 and Lemma 5.16; Stacks 03CY, 06YY, 07A4 and 0GL6. The corresponding local step of lem-pur-etale-brown-level-comparisons.

proof.text: Apply the finite-coefficient proper projection formula after restriction to ordinary scalars; the scalar pullback and direct-image comparisons are invertible, and exact restriction reflects isomorphisms.
